d: Are you the kind of person who thrives in fast-paced environments, loves solving puzzles, and keeps things moving smoothly behind the scenes? If managing daily warehouse operations and optimizing workflows sounds like your jam, we want you on our squad!
At Boutiqaat, our warehouse is where the magic begins, and we’re looking for an Operations Officer who can ensure everything runs like clockwork.
If you're ready to roll up your sleeves, lead with precision, and think three steps ahead, you could be the operations maestro we need!
q: Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, Logistics, Business Admin, or a related field.
3+ years of experience in warehouse, logistics, or e-commerce operations.
Proven skills with ERP/WMS systems and advanced Excel/Google Sheets.
Fluent in English (Arabic is a plus).
Hands-on experience leading teams and solving operational puzzles on the fly.
Ability to stay cool under pressure and even cooler when things go right.

At Boutiqaat, you won’t just join a company you’ll join a movement redefining e-commerce beauty and lifestyle retail. Here, every day offers new challenges, learning opportunities, and a chance to help build a smarter, more efficient operation from the ground up.
Kickstart your career with hands-on experience, expert mentorship, and real impact.
Apply now and be part of something exciting!
r: Coordinate daily warehouse activities to guarantee timely and accurate order fulfillment
Monitor inventory levels and coordinate with procurement to keep shelves stocked
Supervise receiving, storage, and dispatching goods with a keen eye for detail
Implement and improve operational procedures to boost efficiency and safety
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including logistics, supply chain, and customer service
Lead and motivate warehouse staff to achieve daily targets and uphold quality standards
Ensure compliance with health, safety, and security regulations
Analyze data and generate reports to identify trends and improve performance.

d: Executes Financial Accounting activities, under Manager Financial Accounting scope’s acting as senior specialist, and team player for Financial accounting services through: (1) Executes the non-standard accounting, (2) Cross functional and cross business monthly, quarterly and annual process for closing the books and consolidating the financial results., (3) Executes group accounting standards and local GAPP (IFRS), and (4) contribute to maintain the Company Accounting Policy Manual; in order to support financial goals and objectives of the Company while ensuring compliance with both local and international accounting standards for all group entities.

The position will act in accordance with the Company’s Mission, Vision, Values & Strategies, as well as, policies, guidelines, and international standards, supported by an IT Technology platform, HSE standards, Omani’s government & other legal justifications, and best international practices in consonance with national objectives.
q: Capabilities in a similar role will be preferred.
Oil and Gas / Energy industry experience essential
Deep working understanding of financial reporting and analysis.
Experience in dealing with third parties such as state audit, MoF, lenders and investors.
Forward thinking Excellent business and technical report writing skills
Thrives when facing ambiguity and complexity; willingness to explore multiple solutions to a problem.
Strong communicator, both written and verbal, comfort with presenting to all levels of the organization

Excellent interpersonal and communication skills – in particular, listening, oral, written, presentation and influencing skills with a track record of forging strong working relationships with stakeholders.
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, able to assimilate a wide range of information quickly in order to develop an understanding of complex projects.
Exceptionally good knowledge in using PC software.
English (fluent) required; Arabic is an advantage.
Proven effectiveness in accounts payable execution
r: Executes monthly, quarterly, half year and year end Management reporting/Group Reporting, including statutory and consolidation.
Executes external reporting as per Local (IFRS), and as per CMA/MSX/Group guidelines.
Executes closing processes, maintains close calendars and all related close and consolidation procedures and controls.
Prepares compilation of consolidated balance sheets, income statements, statements of cash flows, and other financial statements
Works collaboratively with the financial accounting team to develop financial reports to assists financial reporting, analysis, and business needs.
Gathers and evaluates information gathered from multiple sources, in order to provide insights into business issues and recommend action plan to the functions.
Build a robust consolidated reporting package; includes, but is not limited to, OQ RPI, Logistics, Polymer Marketing, International Offices Statutory & Government reporting.
Coordinate with internal auditors, state auditors and statuary auditors to satisfy their requirements.
Execute pre- procurement activities of the financial accounting team.
Assists in developing/maintaining the Company accounting manual consistent with the Group policy and relevant accounting standards.
Assist in compiling the budget of financial accounting team and monitor the actual performance of the team against the budget.
Fosters an environment in which employees are actively encouraged to identify and implement departmental and company-wide continuous and quality improvement initiatives.
Executes non-standard and complex accounting, such as impairment test for non-financial assets, employee benefits, site restoration, intangibles.
Supports in preparation of technical accounting papers on complex accounting areas such capitalization, investments, derivatives, merger, impairment etc.
Works closely with other departments like treasury, Commercial, Operation, legal and tax.
Collaborates effectively with managers in areas of responsibility to ensure that department objectives, performance metrics, quality measures, and budget targets are achieved.
External: Shareholder, Government, State and external auditors, lenders, consultant
Notable Working Conditions. Office environment, intensive computer screen use, sporadic visits to operation site.
Education requirements: Bachelor’s degree in finance or related field | Professional Accounting certification (desirable)
Language: Exceptional knowledge of written, read, and spoken English (required) | Arabic - Native (desirable)
